title: migration-risk-analysis-skill Input
description: Input contract for migration risk classification and execution plan production

proposed_schema_path.description: Path to the proposed Prisma_Schema_Proposal.prisma or DB_Schema.sql containing the changes to analyze.

current_schema_path.description: Path to the current production/staging schema for diff-based analysis. If omitted, all changes are treated as new (REVERSIBLE by default unless destructive).

target_environments.description: Environments where this migration will be applied. Affects migration command validation.

zero_downtime_required.description: Whether the deployment requires zero-downtime migration. If true, any migration requiring a maintenance window must produce a phased plan.

deployment_strategy_path.description: Optional path to existing Deployment_Strategy.md to append the migration section to.

risk_register_path.description: Optional path to existing Risk_Register.md to append migration risk entries to.
